Key Insights

1. Data Quality > Quantity
500 samples with realistic patterns (AUROC 0.83) beats 100K samples with bad patterns (AUROC 0.50)
2. Realistic SCANIA Wins
Real failure patterns from SCANIA trucks produce the best balance of challenge and learnability
3. Models Can Learn Normal Driving
Train on normal patterns for anomaly detection — failures are deviations from normal
4. GAN Loop Compounds
Each iteration generates more data and improves models recursively

Continuous Learning Strategy

Phase 1: Data Collection — 131GB decoded CAN frames
Phase 2: Pattern Extraction — SCANIA APS failure patterns
Phase 3: Injection Testing — All 5 approaches compared
Phase 4: Full Dataset Processing — Inject failures into 131GB
Phase 5: GAN Loop — Recursive improvement, growing dataset
Phase 6: Production — Deploy best model for real-time inference
